nodes.label: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Frontend
nodes.rationale: Chosen for modern Android development with declarative UI and strong type safety

nodes.label: Supabase Backend
nodes.rationale: Provides PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, and Realtime as a managed backend service

nodes.label: React/Next.js Admin Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Web-based admin interface for match verification and management

nodes.label: Email/Password Authentication
nodes.rationale: Standard authentication method using Supabase Auth

nodes.label: Team Management (3-7 players)
nodes.rationale: Core feature for organizing scrim teams with configurable member limits

nodes.label: Scrim Posting & Search
nodes.rationale: Enables teams to find and schedule practice matches

nodes.label: Real-time Chat Between Team Leaders
nodes.rationale: Communication channel using Supabase Realtime for coordination

nodes.label: Screenshot Upload for Match Verification
nodes.rationale: Proof mechanism for match results using Supabase Storage

nodes.label: XP and Ranking System (7 tiers)
nodes.rationale: Gamification system with Bronze to Grandmaster progression

nodes.label: iOS-Style Design System Integration
nodes.rationale: Enhanced MLBB theme with glassmorphism, refined shadows, iOS typography, and smooth animations for premium feel

nodes.label: MLBB Epic Gaming Fantasy Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Inspired by MLBB's heroic fantasy aesthetic with gold/blue color scheme and dynamic elements conveying competitive energy

nodes.label: Color Palette System
nodes.rationale: Combines iOS system colors with MLBB official colors (Gold, Blue, Dark Blue) for native-feeling UI with gaming identity

nodes.label: iOS-Style Typography System
nodes.rationale: Follows iOS conventions with refined letter spacing and line heights using Rajdhani/Orbitron for headings, Roboto/Montserrat for body, Teko/Chakra Petch for stats

nodes.label: iOS-Style Component Library
nodes.rationale: Includes iOSGlassCard, iOSElevatedCard, iOSPrimaryButton, iOSNavigationBar, iOSBottomSheet for premium feel

nodes.label: Glassmorphism Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Subtle glass backgrounds (72% opacity) with soft border highlights and layered depth for modern aesthetic

nodes.label: iOS-Inspired Motion Design
nodes.rationale: Animations follow iOS conventions with cubic bezier easing for smooth exits, balanced transitions, and bouncy interactions

nodes.label: 7-Tier Ranking Color System
nodes.rationale: Gradient colors from Bronze to Grandmaster for visual progression indication

nodes.label: Public REST API for MLBB Data
nodes.rationale: Provides consistent RESTful structure with flexible hero identifiers and standardized responses for seamless integration
nodes.norm_label: public rest api for mlbb data

nodes.label: Web Playground for Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Form-driven execution at /web/* for interactive endpoint testing with readable responses and code snippets

nodes.label: OpenMLBB Python SDK
nodes.rationale: Official Python SDK with endpoint-level examples for academy, mlbb, user, and addon clients

nodes.label: mlbb-sdk TypeScript SDK
nodes.rationale: Alternative SDK option for TypeScript/JavaScript projects available on npm

nodes.label: Auth and Caching Rules
nodes.rationale: JWT stored in browser cache for 1 day, user info cache uses exact JWT expiry timestamp, navbar displays cached profile snippets

nodes.label: Readable Response UX Rules
nodes.rationale: Structured table-like rendering for objects/arrays, image previews for image URLs, raw JSON and cURL output for each request

nodes.label: OpenMLBB User-Agent Configuration
nodes.rationale: Default User-Agent is 'RoneAI-OpenMLBB-Python-SDK', can be overridden via user_agent parameter

nodes.label: Drip-Feed Architecture
nodes.rationale: Solves 100 req/month X API limit and prevents news spam by releasing articles gradually (+1 every 2 hours) to keep app feeling fresh

nodes.label: Quality Filter System
nodes.rationale: Multi-gate filtering (content length, title length, spam keywords, engagement, duplicates) ensures only real MLBB news enters archive
